body:
Combo Tools
Tired of placing blocks one by one? Want to clear out a massive room in seconds? Combo Tools is a vanilla-friendly utility mod designed to save you time building and mining!

This mod adds powerful, highly configurable new tools with built-in visual wireframe previews so you always know exactly what you are about to build or destroy.

🛠️ The Easy Builder
The ultimate construction tool! Simply put the blocks you want to build with in your off-hand, and use the Easy Builder in your main hand.

Sneak + Right-Click to cycle through 12 different building modes.

Green Wireframe Previews show you exactly where blocks will be placed before you click.

The 12 Modes Include:

Single (1x1): Standard block placement.

Line (1x3): Places a quick 3-block line.

Wall (3x3) & Big Wall (5x5): Instantly erect walls.

Floor (3x3): Perfect for paving roads or floors.

Pillar (3 High): Stacks blocks upwards.

Cube (3x3x3): Places a solid chunk of blocks.

Bridge (Pillared): Builds a bridge outward that automatically shoots support pillars down to the ground!

Stairs Up & Stairs Down: Instantly builds a 5-step staircase.

Circle Platform: Places a rounded, flat 5x5 circle.

Hollow Room (5x5x5): Builds a large room that is completely hollow on the inside!

⛏️ Area-of-Effect Mining Tools
Clear out mountains or dig giant tunnels instantly.

Jackpot Pickaxe: Mines in a massive radius around the block you break.

Yeet Shovel: Excavates massive areas of dirt, sand, and gravel in a single scoop.

Black Wireframe Previews: See exactly which blocks will be destroyed before you swing.
